name: critic_loop_workflow
description: Self-contained generate→critic→revise loop (ADR-0039). The single `code_loop` node compiles to a `@node` async orchestrator that runs three internal LlmAgents until the critic returns the approval phrase. payloadType is a nested schema (Files → FileItem) to also exercise ADR-0037 topological schema emission.

config.description: Generate code, then loop critic+reviser until the critic approves.

generator.instruction: You are an expert developer. Generate code based on the provided specifications.

critic.instruction: Review the code against the specifications. If it meets all requirements, return status 'APPROVED'. Otherwise, return detailed feedback.

reviser.instruction: Fix the provided code based on the critic feedback.
